memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 19 June 2026

Overall equity stands at $8,557 (-14.4% from $10,000 start), with realized losses of -$1,389 across 104 closed trades. The portfolio is in drawdown but shows a clear bifurcation in engine quality that warrants attention.

SHORT_FAVORITE remains the validated core: 30W/15L on sports markets (69% win rate, CI 57-81%) and is the only engine with a structural edge confirmed by the hypothesis engine. However, several large stop-outs (-$750 stakes on LoL, Dota2, Baltimore, Toronto) have badly damaged the P&L. The $750 maxEventExposure cap was previously in force but these trades appear to have been sized at the cap — the issue is the cap itself was too high given the Brier score (0.263, above the 0.25 breakeven threshold for calibration). We need to tighten per-trade sizing further.

MOMENTUM (disabled) and SMART_CONSENSUS (disabled) — correct to leave off. MOMENTUM showed 8W/13L (-$1,019) and SMART_CONSENSUS 0W/1L (-$385).

ELITE_FOLLOW shows a nuanced picture: the Iran diplomatic cluster produced five consecutive losers on the same market (ELITE_FOLLOW copying wallet 'aenews2' scoring only 0.30), but separate ELITE_FOLLOW trades on other wallets (denizz 0.8, PatrocIus 0.6) were profitable. The system needs to filter by wallet score more aggressively — aenews2 should be blacklisted.

VOLUME_SPIKE at 8W/12L with +$190 net is marginally positive but noisy. Keep enabled at reduced size.

Action: Reduce kellyMult to 0.12 to cut sizing on all engines. Lower maxEventExposure to $600 to prevent single-event concentration. Hold pMin at 0.57.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE validated on sports (69% WR, CI 57-81%) but large stops on esports/tennis causing outsized drawdowns — these categories need scrutiny
MOMENTUM disabled correctly: 8W/13L, -$1,019 PnL, no edge signal
ELITE_FOLLOW wallet 'aenews2' scores 0.30 — responsible for Iran diplomatic cluster of 5 losers; high-scoring wallets (denizz 0.8, PatrocIus 0.6) were net profitable
VOLUME_SPIKE marginally positive (+$190) but high variance, 8W/12L, keep but constrain size
Brier score 0.263 indicates model is overconfident — pPredicted consistently higher than realized win rates outside sports
Multiple $750 max-cap stakes hit stop-loss sequentially (Dota2 -$470, LoL -$503, Toronto -$402, Baltimore -$377) — single event cap was too generous relative to bank size
ELITE_FOLLOW Iran positions entered at sub-0.40 probability — far below pMin threshold of 0.57, suggesting pMin filter was not enforced on these entries
Open position on 'Iran agrees to end enrichment' (ELITE_FOLLOW, entry 0.735, cur 0.675) is underwater and at high nominal entry price — adverse selection risk
Equity drawdown -14.4% approaching threshold where further losses could compromise minimum viable bank
changeReasoning: Reducing kellyMult from 0.15 to 0.12 to shrink per-trade sizing across all engines — the sequential $750 stop-outs demonstrate sizing is too aggressive relative to our prediction accuracy (Brier 0.263). Reducing maxEventExposure from $750 to $600 adds a further hard cap to prevent any single event from absorbing more than ~7% of current equity. maxExposure nudged from 0.40 to 0.38 to reduce aggregate deployment risk during drawdown. pMin held at 0.57 — evidence of ELITE_FOLLOW entries appearing below this threshold suggests a code-level enforcement issue worth auditing rather than raising pMin further and eliminating borderline positive signals. MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS remain disabled — no evidence to reinstate. ELITE_FOLLOW kept enabled but the aenews2 wallet scoring 0.30 should be hard-blacklisted at the wallet scoring layer, not via parameter changes.
riskFlags: ELITE_FOLLOW entries on Iran diplomatic markets appear to have bypassed pMin=0.57 filter — entries recorded at 0.387-0.418, well below threshold; requires code audit
Wallet 'aenews2' (score 0.30) is still active in wallet tracking — recommend hard blacklist at score < 0.40 to prevent further copying
Esports markets (Dota2, LoL) have produced three of the four largest single-trade losses; consider adding a sport-category exclusion list for esports within SHORT_FAVORITE
Equity at $8,557 (-14.4%): if drawdown reaches -25% ($7,500) a full operational review and potential suspension of new entries is warranted
Open ELITE_FOLLOW position on 'Iran enrichment' entered at 0.735 is deeply underwater (cur 0.675) and carries continuation risk if resolution is negative — monitor for early exit
